method: Same binary core exports retained. Historical baseline is Vite ES library mode with whitespace retained. Oxc client keeps the same exports with preserveEntrySignatures=strict; Terser uses module=true, ecma=2022, unsafe defaults=false and preserve_annotations=true. gzip9/Brotli11 per core. No host/catalog/persistence or application total. 33 core variants each run the original 1000 queries against native SQLite; additional typed/persistence/optional-feature checks compare the unminified core. Existing production Worker is size-only if available. Experimental only: production configuration and dependencies are unchanged. No timing/speed guarantee or universal equivalence claim.

verification.method: Each profile/variant: 1000 original upstream queries against native node:sqlite, exact exported names and binary snapshot bytes against unminified engine, Int64/negative zero/BLOB/BOM/NUL, duplicate PK/transaction rollback/corrupt snapshot; full profile also JSON/date/window/STRICT/FK/trigger/default timestamp.
